Pattern-Problem Surface for Visual Label Placement

centralContract: Compare popular defaults and fit-for-purpose front-end compositions through separate probability objects, dimensional fit, equal low-fidelity spikes, explicit gaps, and reversible decision records.
loadBearingDeterminations: Framework popularity and contextual fit remain separate questions.
Default-likelihood and six-month-fit probabilities use separate probability objects and set semantics.
Technical gaps are first-class alongside methodological, organizational, evidence, and boundary gaps.
A front-end stack is modeled as composable layers rather than one monolithic framework label.
The first decision selects equal low-fidelity spikes rather than a durable stack mandate.
Weighted dimensional fit remains separate from probability and formal statistical fit.
Practitioner Probe records preserve question, what-it-reveals, technical-core, edge-case, and AI-directive fields.
All twenty Core Architecture cards remain available as routes.
Target-local edits and AI imports create reviewable successor state.
Aligned common-scale charts and structured tables carry consequential comparisons.

seedDecision.decisionRule: Select two candidates whose combined spike set creates the most information gain across accessibility, SVG control, maintainability, and replacement seams while preserving materially different framework commitments.
seedDecision.rationale: React + CSS Modules + headless primitives represents a high-ecosystem middle ground with explicit seams. Svelte + component-scoped CSS provides a lower-ceremony compiler-oriented contrast. Equal fixtures can reveal whether the additional React ecosystem commitment produces material collaboration value for this surface.
seedDecision.dissentOrMinorityRead: A platform-first Web Components spike may create stronger long-horizon evidence and should enter the next round when the initial two spikes leave swapability or operational-calm questions unresolved.
seedDecision.reviewAfter: After both equal spikes and a Plus / Delta review

probabilityObjects.label: Generic LLM first-recommendation likelihood
probabilityObjects.statement: P(generic-LLM-first-recommendation | the named prompt condition): the model-verbalized probability that a candidate appears as the first recommendation under that request.
probabilityObjects.normalizationRule: Listed candidates plus other/tail mass sum to one.

probabilityObjects.label: Six-month collaboration fit
probabilityObjects.statement: P(six-month-fit-without-structural-rewrite | declared outcome, team conditions, and current evidence): the contextual planning probability that a candidate supports the selected low-fidelity interaction surfaces for six months while preserving accessibility, semantic readability, maintainability, testability, and a practical replacement path.
probabilityObjects.normalizationRule: Candidate estimates are independent and need not sum to one.
